verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Asana has automation features: rule actions, webhooks, the API, and AI Studio "no-code automations". None of it documents a schedule-based or recurring trigger for a workflow. Webhooks and the API are developer building blocks that react to changes, not recurring schedules. Third-party tools like Zapier and n8n are external workarounds, so no direct support for scheduled or recurring workflows is evidenced.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can create a workflow that runs on a schedule or recurring event to handle routine team work
